newsitem.title: USA: Elxsi adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Elxsi adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: ELXSI Corp said on Wednesday that its board has adopted a new stock purchase rights plan to assure that its shareholders are treated fairly if a proposed takeover arises.
The company has declared a dividend of one stock purchase right for each share of common stock payable on June 16, 1997.
The rights plan is effective if a person or group acquires more than 15 percent of the company's common stock or makes a tender offer for that amount, ELXSI said.
ELXSI said chairman, president and chief executive Alexander Milley and related persons may acquire up to 35 percent of the company's common stock without causing the rights to become exercisable.
Milley and related persons own 23 percent, ELXSI said.
Each right will entitle the holder to buy at the $25.00 exercise price an amount of ELXSI common stock having a market value equal to twice that price, the company said.
The rights plan expires on June 15, 2007, it said.
